record.scope: The two units in appliesTo declare DETECT: Patrat (1 star) and Watchog (2 stars); both range 2, maxPP 100, no passive. The strategy is shared; unit differences are the star index into the duration table.
record.summary: Inherits requiresTarget = true (the caster needs a target in range, unlike self-cast abilities). It counts enemy units within range 2 of the caster, then gives the Protect status to every allied unit in the 8 adjacent cells (not the caster) for round(500 / 600 ms (1 / 2 stars) x enemies counted x (1 + AP/100) x crit power). With zero enemies counted the duration is 0. Protect cannot be applied to a unit that is already protected or enraged.

targeting.who: allied units in the 8 cells adjacent to the caster; enemies within range 2 only determine the duration
targeting.note: The target is passed to process but never used; only the caster position matters. The caster itself is excluded from both the adjacent-ally list and the enemy count (center excluded in both helpers).

geometry.shape: 3x3 block around the caster (center excluded) for allies; range-2 area (distanceC <= 2, center excluded) for the enemy count

effects.scaling: requested duration = round(table x enemiesInRange2 x (1 + AP/100) x (crit ? critPower : 1)). Duration, not an amount: Big Eater Belt and Twist Band do not apply.
effects.resolution: requested duration -> triggerProtect(timer): ignored for a unit that is already protected (no refresh) or enraged; otherwise protect = true and protectCooldown = timer; ends in updateProtect when the cooldown would reach 0 (a duration of 0 ends on the next status update).

statusEffects.effect: protect on adjacent allies (not stackable, not on enraged units)

starBehavior.note: table index is the casting entity's stars; 800 and 1000 are not reached at the factory star counts of these units. Whether other mechanics change an entity's star count was not examined.

record.positionalConditions: Allies must stand in one of the 8 cells next to the caster; enemies must be within distanceC <= 2 of the caster. Caster excluded from both.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state. An ally still protected from an earlier cast is not refreshed.
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw: 500 / 600 ms per detected enemy (1 / 2 stars). Requested duration = raw x enemies x (1 + AP/100) x crit factor, rounded; applied only if the ally is neither protected nor enraged.
